2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 hard decades:  

Create a sophisticated abstract geometric illustration of
[SUBJECT], using a distinctive artistic style combining
Bauhaus-inspired geometry, mid-century modern graphic design,
Art Deco ornamentation, and flowing botanical abstraction.

Use the uploaded image as a STYLE reference when provided.
Preserve its visual construction, geometric vocabulary,
ornamental rhythm, color intensity, and compositional logic
without literally copying the depicted abstract motif.

C₀  SUBJECT IDENTITY + ABSTRACT TRANSLATION (highest priority)

    Analyze [SUBJECT] and identify its defining silhouette,
    characteristic shapes, proportions, recognizable features,
    physical structure, movement, and visual personality.

    Preserve the subject's essential identity while translating
    its appearance into an entirely new geometric-organic
    illustration.

    Reduce recognizable features into combinations of bold
    circular shapes, decorative curves, pointed extensions,
    sweeping black-and-white ribbons, and negative space.

    For recognizable people, reinterpret defining hairstyles,
    facial profiles, clothing silhouettes, or characteristic
    gestures through abstract geometric structures.

    For animals, preserve recognizable species traits through
    stylized silhouettes and ornamental reinterpretation.

    For flowers, plants, or other organic subjects, translate
    natural growth into geometric petals, leaves, stems,
    and radial botanical structures.

    For objects or abstract concepts, preserve characteristic
    geometry without automatically introducing flowers,
    faces, or human anatomy.

    The result should remain visually connected to [SUBJECT]
    even when highly abstracted.

    ¬C₀ = generic abstract symbol / unrecognizable subject /
    literal copying of reference motif / random decorative
    shapes / forced botanical anatomy / unrelated symbols.

C₁  GEOMETRIC-ORGANIC SHAPE FUSION (master)

    Build the entire composition from an elegant combination
    of rigid mathematical geometry and flowing organic forms.

    PRIMARY GEOMETRIC ELEMENTS:

    - Large segmented circles.
    - Semicircular discs and quarter-circle shapes.
    - Circular fans and radial segments.
    - Bold black circular masses.
    - White geometric cutouts.
    - Concentric arcs.
    - Overlapping crescent shapes.
    - Precisely positioned curved wedges.

    PRIMARY ORGANIC ELEMENTS:

    - Elongated pointed leaf-like shapes.
    - Flowing black-and-white ribbon forms.
    - Tapered calligraphic strokes.
    - Stylized petal structures.
    - Abstract botanical flourishes.
    - Sharp spear-like extensions.
    - Curved ornamental tendrils.
    - Asymmetric flower-inspired silhouettes.

    Combine these elements into a single coherent
    abstract interpretation of [SUBJECT].

    Favor large circular structures interrupted by
    fluid, elongated organic forms.

    Let bold black shapes interact with white
    negative-space cutouts.

    Use strong contrast between thick graphic masses
    and extremely thin linear extensions.

    The composition should feel carefully engineered
    but organically expressive.

    Avoid conventional character illustration.
    The subject should appear reconstructed through
    artistic geometry rather than drawn realistically.

    ¬C₁ = realistic anatomy / conventional illustration /
    random geometric collage / ordinary flower drawing /
    generic circular icon / messy curves /
    weak shape relationships.

C₂  ORNAMENTAL BOTANICAL CALIGRAPHY + RADIAL DETAIL

    Introduce a refined system of decorative geometric
    marks and calligraphic botanical structures.

    Use carefully placed ornamental details including:

    - Small circular dots.
    - Short radial black dashes.
    - Thin concentric arc segments.
    - Tiny outlined gold or yellow rings.
    - Delicate looping curves.
    - Short decorative lines.
    - Small asymmetric petal clusters.
    - Fine spear-like extensions.
    - Repeating angular markings.
    - Decorative leaf-like flourishes.

    Arrange small details around larger geometric
    focal shapes to suggest movement and rhythm.

    Use radial markings selectively along
    semicircular or circular boundaries.

    Let some curved elements overlap or connect
    with large discs through thin elegant lines.

    Create unusual botanical structures through
    black-and-white stripe patterns, flowing
    nested contours, and tapered forms.

    Favor organic visual rhythm rather than
    strict repetitive symmetry.

    Decorative elements should feel integrated
    into the subject's abstract identity.

    Each detail must contribute to the overall
    composition, not simply fill empty space.

    ¬C₂ = random floating icons / excessive decoration /
    generic mandala patterns / perfectly repetitive
    radial symmetry / mechanical technical diagrams /
    disconnected ornamental marks.

C₃  ASYMMETRIC COMPOSITION + DIRECTIONAL ENERGY

    Construct a visually dynamic arrangement with
    a strong central geometric-organic motif.

    Use asymmetrical balance rather than conventional
    centered symmetry.

    Establish one large primary focal structure
    composed of intersecting circular and organic shapes.

    Extend selected forms outward using dramatically
    elongated tapered points or flowing ribbons.

    Introduce strong directional contrast:

    - Long horizontal extensions.
    - Sharp vertical downward points.
    - Sweeping circular movements.
    - Diagonal organic curves.
    - Compact central masses.
    - Small circular accents.

    Use dramatic differences in scale.

    Balance large black-and-white shapes with
    fine decorative marks and delicate curved lines.

    Make negative space an active component
    of the design.

    Allow the composition to feel energetic
    without becoming visually chaotic.

    Every major form should connect visually
    to the central structure.

    The result should resemble an abstract
    ornamental emblem with unexpected movement
    and sophisticated geometric balance.

    ¬C₃ = rigid bilateral symmetry / centered ordinary
    logo / repetitive circular patterns / cluttered
    composition / disconnected elements /
    weak directional rhythm / flat visual hierarchy.

C₄  SOLAR ORANGE PALETTE + BLACK-WHITE GRAPHIC CONTRAST

    Use a bold, highly restricted color system.

    PRIMARY COLORS:

    - Brilliant golden yellow.
    - Warm sunflower yellow.
    - Rich orange.
    - Burnt orange.
    - Vermilion.
    - Pure black.
    - Pure white.

    Build the background from large regions
    of warm yellow, orange, and red-orange.

    Use broad rectangular color divisions
    combined with subtle tonal transitions.

    Create a luminous solar atmosphere through
    warm color relationships rather than
    realistic light effects.

    The main ornamental structure should remain
    predominantly black and white.

    Allow small yellow or orange accents inside
    the abstract motif where useful.

    Favor large uninterrupted areas of color.

    Use crisp graphic boundaries with no
    photographic surface detail.

    Selectively introduce gentle color gradients
    within background regions to add warmth
    without creating three-dimensional shading.

    The black-and-white shapes should remain
    exceptionally clean and high-contrast.

    Use color to strengthen the composition's
    energetic and retro-modernist identity.

    ¬C₄ = pastel palette / rainbow colors /
    realistic lighting / metallic reflections /
    glossy shading / textured oil paint /
    photorealistic surfaces / excessive gradients /
    uncontrolled color variation.

C₅  MID-CENTURY ABSTRACT POSTER PRESENTATION

    Present the artwork as a refined geometric
    illustration suitable for a premium
    mid-century-inspired art print.

    DEFAULT COMPOSITION:

    A square canvas with the main ornamental
    composition centered or slightly offset.

    Fill the background with large geometric
    regions of yellow, orange, and vermilion.

    Position the abstract subject so that
    its largest circular structures occupy
    the primary visual focus.

    Allow elongated botanical extensions
    to reach toward the composition's
    horizontal and vertical boundaries.

    Maintain visual tension between the
    central organic motif and the flat
    geometric background.

    Do not add realistic perspective,
    conventional cast shadows, or physical depth.

    Use only graphic overlap, shape intersections,
    and subtle background color shifts
    to establish visual layering.

    Keep all essential forms visible.

    Avoid ornamental frames, typography,
    unnecessary scenery, and decorative borders.

    MULTI-SUBJECT ADAPTATION:

    If multiple subjects are requested,
    create a grid of distinct abstract compositions.

    Preserve the same geometric vocabulary,
    black-and-white ornamentation,
    warm solar palette, and graphic style.

    Give each subject its own unique central
    shape system, direction of movement,
    and ornamental structure.

    Avoid repeating the identical emblem
    across multiple panels.

    ¬C₅ = realistic environment / photographic depth /
    3D studio rendering / elaborate scenery /
    ordinary centered logo / poster typography /
    decorative borders / repetitive compositions.

η   HONEST GRAPHIC RENDER

    Render as sophisticated two-dimensional
    vector-inspired abstract illustration.

    Emphasize:

    - Precisely constructed circular geometry.
    - Large solid black-and-white forms.
    - Sharp pointed organic extensions.
    - Elegant flowing curved ribbons.
    - Fine radial ornamental details.
    - Carefully balanced negative space.
    - Refined asymmetric composition.
    - Dynamic interaction between circles and curves.
    - Brilliant warm background color fields.
    - Controlled high-contrast silhouettes.
    - Clean graphic edges.
    - Subtle mid-century modern design sensibility.

    Preserve an intentional contrast between
    mathematical precision and expressive
    organic movement.

    Avoid unnecessary shading and dimensionality.

    The finished image should resemble a
    sophisticated contemporary geometric
    art print inspired by mid-century modernism,
    ornamental botanical abstraction,
    and experimental modernist illustration.

    Bold, playful, rhythmic, elegant,
    imaginative, energetic, and visually memorable.

FORBIDDEN = photorealism · 3D CGI · realistic anatomy ·
    conventional character illustration · detailed faces ·
    painterly realism · glossy material surfaces ·
    metallic reflections · complex lighting ·
    excessive color variety · random geometric clutter ·
    generic mandala · repetitive floral patterns ·
    realistic flowers · flat stock icons ·
    disconnected ornamental elements ·
    elaborate backgrounds · decorative borders ·
    unnecessary typography · watermarks.

创作一幅精致复杂的抽象几何插画，描绘
[SUBJECT]，采用独特的艺术风格，融合
包豪斯启发的几何、中世纪现代平面设计、

在提供上传图像时，将其作为风格参考。
保留其视觉构成、几何语汇、装饰节奏、色彩强度和构图逻辑，
但不要照搬所描绘的抽象母题。

C₀  主体身份 + 抽象转译（最高优先级）

    分析 [SUBJECT]，识别其标志性剪影、
    特征性形状、比例、可辨识特征、
    物理结构、运动方式和视觉个性。

    转译为全新的几何—有机插画。

    将可辨识特征还原为大胆圆形形状、
    装饰性曲线、尖锐延伸结构、
    流动的黑白飘带，以及负空间的组合。

    对于可辨识的人物，通过抽象几何结构
    重新诠释其标志性发型、面部轮廓、
    服饰剪影或特有姿态。

    对于动物，通过风格化剪影和装饰性再诠释
    保留可辨识的物种特征。

    对于花卉、植物或其他有机主体，将
    自然生长转译为几何花瓣、叶片、茎秆
    以及放射状植物结构。

    对于物体或抽象概念，保留其特征性几何形态，
    不要自动引入花卉、面部或人体解剖结构。

    即使高度抽象化，结果仍应与 [SUBJECT]
    在视觉上保持关联。

    ¬C₀ = 泛泛的抽象符号 / 无法辨识的主体 /
    对参考母题的照搬 / 随意堆砌的装饰
    形状 / 生硬的植物解剖结构 / 无关的符号。

C₁  几何—有机形态融合（母版）

    用严谨的数学几何与流动的有机形态的

    主要几何元素：

    - 大型分割圆形。
    - 半圆盘与四分之一圆形。

    - 大胆的黑色圆形块面。
    - 白色几何镂空。
    - 同心弧线。
    - 相互叠加的新月形。
    - 精确布置的弧形楔块。

    主要有机元素：

    - 细长的尖叶形。
    - 流动的黑白飘带形态。
    - 收尖的书法式笔画。
    - 风格化的花瓣结构。
    - 抽象植物花饰。
    - 锋利的矛状延伸。
    - 弯曲的装饰性卷须。
    - 不对称的花朵启发式剪影。

    将这些元素融合为对 [SUBJECT]
    的单一连贯抽象诠释。

    偏好被流动、修长的有机形态
    打断的大型圆形结构。

    让大胆的黑色形状与白色
    负空间镂空相互作用。

    在厚重的图形块面与极细的线性延伸之间
    形成强烈对比。

    构图应显得精心构建，
    同时富有有机表现力。

    避免常规的角色插画表现方式。
    主体应显得是通过艺术几何
    重新建构而成，而非写实绘制。

    ¬C₁ = 写实解剖 / 常规插画 /
    随意的几何拼贴 / 平庸的花卉画 /
    泛泛的圆形图标 / 凌乱的曲线 /
    薄弱的关系形态。

C₂  装饰性植物书法 + 放射状细节

    引入一套精致的装饰几何标记
    与书法式植物结构体系。

    精心布置以下装饰细节：

    - 小型圆点。
    - 短促的黑色放射状短线。
    - 纤细的同心弧段。
    - 微小的描边金色或黄色圆环。
    - 精巧的环形曲线。
    - 短装饰线。
    - 小型不对称花瓣簇。
    - 精细的矛状延伸。
    - 重复出现的角度标记。
    - 装饰性叶形花饰。

    将小细节布置在较大的几何
    焦点形状周围，以暗示运动感与节奏。

    选择性地沿半圆形或圆形边界
    使用放射状标记。

    让部分曲线元素通过纤细优雅的线条
    与大型圆盘重叠或相连。

    通过黑白条纹图案、流动的
    嵌套轮廓与收尖形态，创造
    不寻常的植物结构。

    偏好有机的视觉节奏，而非
    严格重复的对称。

    装饰元素应感觉已融入
    主体的抽象身份之中。

    每一处细节都必须服务于整体构图，
    而不仅仅是为了填补空白。

    ¬C₂ = 随意漂浮的图标 / 过度装饰 /
    泛泛的曼陀罗图案 / 完美重复的
    放射对称 / 机械的技术图示 /
    脱节的装饰标记。

C₃  不对称构图 + 方向性能量

    构建一个视觉上充满动感的布局，
    拥有一个强有力的中心几何—有机母题。

    使用不对称平衡，而非常规的
    居中对称。

    建立一个大型主要焦点结构，
    由相互交叠的圆形与有机形状构成。

    通过极具拉伸感的收尖点或流动飘带
    将部分形态向外延伸。

    引入强烈的方向性对比：

    - 长横向延伸。
    - 锋利的垂直向下尖端。
    - 横扫的圆周运动。
    - 斜向的有机曲线。
    - 紧凑的中心块面。
    - 小型圆形点缀。

    使用戏剧性的尺度差异。

    以精细装饰标记和纤巧曲线
    平衡大尺度的黑白形状。

    让负空间成为设计的
    主动构成部分。

    允许构图富有能量，
    但不陷入视觉混乱。

    每一个主要形态都应在视觉上
    与中心结构相连。

    最终结果应 resembles 一枚抽象
    装饰徽章，带有出人意料的运动感
    与精致的几何平衡。

    ¬C₃ = 僵硬的双侧对称 / 平庸的居中
    徽标 / 重复的圆形图案 / 拥挤的
    构图 / 脱节的元素 /
    薄弱的方向节奏 / 平扁的视觉层级。

C₄  太阳橙色调色板 + 黑白图形对比

    - 暖向日葵黄。
    - 浓郁橙色。
    - 焦橙。
    - 朱红色。
    - 纯黑。
    - 纯白。

    照片级真实表面 / 过度渐变 /
    不受控的色彩变化。

C₅  中世纪现代抽象海报呈现

    方形画布，主要装饰构图
    居中或略微偏移。

    用黄色、橙色和朱红色的
    大块几何区域填满背景。

    安排抽象主体的位置，使其
    最大的圆形结构占据主要视觉焦点。

    允许修长的植物延伸结构
    延伸至构图的
    水平与垂直边界。

    在中央有机母题与
    扁平几何背景之间保持视觉张力。

    不要添加写实透视、
    常规投射阴影或物理纵深。

    仅使用图形叠压、形状穿插
    与细微的背景色偏移
    来建立视觉层次。

    保持所有必要形态清晰可见。

    避免装饰边框、字体排印、
    不必要的场景以及装饰性边界。

    多主体适配：

    如果请求多个主体，
    创作一组各不相同的抽象构图网格。

    保持相同的几何语汇、
    黑白装饰手法、
    暖色太阳调色板与图形风格。

    为每个主体赋予其独有的中心
    形状体系、运动方向
    与装饰结构。

    避免在多个画板中
    重复完全相同的徽章。

    ¬C₅ = 写实环境 / 摄影级纵深 /
    3D 影棚渲染 / 繁复场景 /
    平庸的居中徽标 / 海报字体排印 /
    装饰边框 / 重复的构图。

η   诚实的图形呈现

    呈现为精致复杂的二维
    矢量风格抽象插画。

    强调：

    - 精确构建的圆形几何。
    - 大面积纯色黑白形态。
    - 锐利的尖形有机延伸。
    - 优雅流动的曲线飘带。
    - 精细的放射状装饰细节。
    - 精心平衡的负空间。
    - 精致的不对称构图。
    - 圆形与曲线之间的动态互动。
    - 明亮的暖色背景色块。
    - 受控的高对比剪影。
    - 干净的图形边缘。
    - 含蓄的中世纪现代设计感。

    保持数学精确性与富有表现力的
    有机运动之间的
    刻意对比。

    避免不必要的明暗与立体感。

    完成的图像应类似于一幅
    精致现代的几何艺术印刷品，
    灵感来自中世纪现代主义、
    装饰性植物抽象
    与实验性现代主义插画。

服饰主体为典型明制婚礼服制：内层中式立领或圆领中衣，外层红色大袖嫁衣，肩背披挂完整霞帔，霞帔自肩部自然下垂，边缘纹样、前胸结构、披挂关系清楚可辨；下身为层叠式长裙或马面裙结构，裙摆完整展开但不过度飞扬；腰间有清晰腰封、丝绦、玉佩、流苏垂饰；脚穿精致中式绣花婚鞋。整套服饰以正红与金色为主，辅以少量珠白与翠色点缀，布满龙凤纹、牡丹纹、祥云纹、团花纹和金线刺绣。丝绸、织锦、缎面、金线、珠饰、金属饰件的材质差异明确，层次丰富，贵气华丽但真实自然。

强调服装各组成部分边界清晰、层级明确，凤冠、耳饰、霞帔、内层衣襟、外层嫁衣、大袖、腰封、裙装、绣花鞋、玉佩和流苏都应清楚可见，适合作为后续“逐件穿上、逐层叠加”的动画完成态底图。不要夸张飘带遮挡主体，不要复杂前景遮挡，不要大幅摆动裙摆，不要手持团扇、捧花、灯笼等额外道具，不要红盖头完全遮住脸部；如出现红盖头，可轻搭于后方或肩后，不影响面部与凤冠展示。

画面采用真实写实摄影风格，电影级但自然克制，低AI感，真实皮肤质感，真实服装褶皱，真实金属与珠饰反光，细节高清。构图为严格9:16竖版，全身完整入镜，头顶与裙摆都留有充足空间，主体位于画面中央略偏下，整体结构稳定，便于后续视频延展。镜头为正面全身人像视角，轻微人像透视，避免广角畸变，人物比例自然修长。

2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 scientists: Create a premium hand-drawn character illustration of [SUBJECT] using the following artistic system. Interpret the supplied image as the primary STYLE reference when available, preserving its illustrated visual language without automatically copying the depicted characters.

C₀  SUBJECT IDENTITY + VISUAL ADAPTATION (highest priority)
    Analyze [SUBJECT] and identify its defining silhouette, facial features, hairstyle, physical structure, signature expression, characteristic clothing, and recognizable visual details.
    Preserve the subject's identity while reinterpreting its shapes in an eccentric, deliberately disproportionate storybook illustration aesthetic.
    Translate distinctive features through expressive silhouette exaggeration and simplified hand-drawn anatomy, rather than requiring realistic facial details.
    For multiple subjects, maintain distinct identities while introducing strong contrast between their body shapes, proportions, expressions, and textures.
    Preserve animals' species-defining anatomy and objects' fundamental geometry without automatically introducing horns, teeth, faces, or humanoid limbs.
    ¬C₀ = generic character / lost likeness / unrelated features / identical body templates / copying the reference monsters onto every subject.

C₁  EXTREME STORYBOOK PROPORTIONS + ECCENTRIC SHAPE LANGUAGE (master)
    Reimagine [SUBJECT] as an eccentric hand-drawn storybook character with dramatically exaggerated proportions and a distinct, unconventional silhouette.
    Use strong contrast between oversized rounded masses and exceptionally narrow elongated structures.
    Depending on the subject, explore huge pear-shaped torsos, compressed heads, impossibly slender necks, thin stick-like legs, tiny arms, oversized facial features, long floppy appendages, crooked curves, irregular protrusions, or dramatically simplified body masses.
    Preserve enough recognizable anatomy for subject identification while embracing deliberately absurd proportions.
    Favor strongly asymmetrical shapes, expressive negative space, loose organic contours, and visual simplicity at a distance.
    Each character should feel individually designed, not generated from a standardized cartoon body template.
    ¬C₁ = realistic anatomy / conventional cute proportions / uniform head-to-body ratios / polished vector shapes / generic cartoon silhouette / identical character proportions.

C₂  DEADPAN FACIAL ACTING + QUIRKY PERSONALITY
    Use wonderfully understated, character-specific expressions: sleepy, mildly confused, unimpressed, suspicious, melancholy, bewildered, quietly irritated, or awkwardly content.
    Favor tiny eyes within oversized facial shapes, heavy drooping eyelids, uneven eye placement, understated mouths, prominent or compressed noses, sparse expressive eyebrows, and irregular teeth only where appropriate to the original subject.
    Draw facial features with a few economical, slightly imperfect strokes.
    Subtle asymmetry in eyelid placement, eye direction, mouth curvature, and posture should communicate personality without theatrical exaggeration.
    Simplify facial anatomy into memorable illustrated shapes while preserving defining features of recognizable people or characters.
    ¬C₂ = generic happy cartoon expression / enormous sparkling eyes / glossy 3D eyeballs / perfect symmetrical face / emoji-like expressions / exaggerated cheerful smiles / random monster anatomy.

C₃  EXPRESSIVE DRY-BRUSH TEXTURES + HAND-DRAWN CONSTRUCTION
    Render the entire character through a combination of opaque gouache-like color fills, scratchy colored-pencil strokes, dry-brush marks, broken ink lines, and irregular hand-painted texturing.
    FUR: Suggest shaggy, coarse, uneven fur using hundreds of loose directional pencil and dry-brush strokes, sparse protruding strands, scratchy tufts, and intentionally inconsistent density. Preserve large flat color masses beneath the texture rather than rendering individual photorealistic hairs.
    SKIN: Use simplified matte color shapes, sparse pencil hatching, subtle pigment variation, irregular spots, and occasional sketchy crease lines. No realistic skin shaders.
    CLOTHING: Reinterpret [SIGNATURE_OUTFIT] using broad irregular painted shapes, rough fabric outlines, loosely drawn seams, simplified knitted patterns, sweater ribs, stitched accents, and short dry-brush strokes that suggest worn fibers.
    HARD DETAILS: Render horns, teeth, claws, shoes, accessories, or structural parts with simplified flat shapes, rough painted edges, sparse crosshatching, and a few graphic highlights.
    Allow certain marks to extend slightly beyond painted boundaries. Keep contours imperfect and intentionally handmade.
    ¬C₃ = photographic fur / volumetric CGI hair / realistic knitted-fabric rendering / perfectly smooth digital gradients / vector linework / airbrushed surfaces / highly polished textures.

C₄  MUTED GOUACHE PALETTE + ILLUSTRATED COLOR BEHAVIOR
    Use a restricted painterly palette based on muted slate blue, dusty blue-gray, faded lavender, warm cream, parchment beige, burnt orange, rusty terracotta, charcoal black, and subdued ochre.
    Adapt the actual color choices to [SUBJECT] while preserving the reference's quiet warm-cool harmony and restrained saturation.
    Apply colors in broad, mostly flat hand-painted regions with imperfect boundaries and occasional paper-grain exposure.
    Introduce sparse dark spots, isolated warm accents, irregular patches, loose scribbled highlights, and lightly textured overlapping pigment where relevant.
    Use minimal dimensional shading. Let shape, linework, texture, and carefully placed color contrasts establish form.
    Keep painted surfaces opaque to softly translucent with no shiny synthetic reflections.
    ¬C₄ = neon colors / rainbow palette / plastic gloss / 3D gradients / metallic reflections / excessive digital color blending / perfect flat vector fills / photorealistic shading.

C₅  MINIMALIST STORYBOOK PRESENTATION
    Present [SUBJECT] as a complete full-body or full-object hand-drawn illustration on a warm off-white paper background.
    Use a straightforward frontal or subtle three-quarter composition, generous negative space, and visually balanced placement.
    Ground the character using only a sparse horizontal pencil or dry-brush line beneath the feet and minimal contact marks.
    Avoid conventional cinematic lighting. Use flat illustrated light logic with small painted value changes and occasional hatching.
    Keep all character details visible, including extremities, prominent appendages, and silhouette-defining elements.
    For multiple characters, maintain a coherent visual language while contrasting their proportions, textures, body masses, and gestures.
    ¬C₅ = 3D studio setup / cinematic lighting / detailed landscape / elaborate interior / dramatic cast shadows / gradients behind characters / cropping / decorative clutter.

η   HONEST ILLUSTRATION
    Authentic hand-drawn character-design craftsmanship, imperfect gouache pigmentation, loose colored-pencil texture, restrained charcoal-style outlines, tactile paper grain, broken dry-brush marks, expressive economy of line, irregular shapes, matte painted surfaces, simplified visual depth, strong silhouette readability, and unusual emotional personality.
    Preserve visible human-made irregularities: inconsistent stroke density, slight contour wobble, stray pencil marks, overlapping paint, incomplete edges, and sparse sketch-like details.
    The finished artwork should resemble a sophisticated contemporary illustrated character-design sheet: dryly humorous, slightly melancholic, beautifully awkward, rough-edged, graphically bold, and full of unconventional personality.

FORBIDDEN = 3D CGI · photorealistic rendering · realistic fur grooming · smooth digital painting · perfect vector art · glossy vinyl · plastic materials · hyperreal eyes · realistic shadows · cinematic rim lighting · generic cute cartoon faces · identical proportions · oversaturated color palette · smooth gradient backgrounds · excessive detail · elaborate scenery · unrelated monster features · text labels · artist signatures · watermarks.

Day 05 | Turn Ordinary Photos into Beautiful Oil Painting Posters

One prompt a day. Endless creative possibilities.

What if your everyday photos could become beautiful, hand-painted magazine covers?

Today, I’m sharing one of my favorite AI image transformations:

Real Photography × Impasto Oil Painting × Summer Editorial Design

No painting skills. No complicated editing.

Just one photo and one detailed prompt.

I tried it with four different scenes:

🌊 Mediterranean Escape — A sunny coastal village transformed into a vibrant oil painting.

🍒 Slow Summer Days — A peaceful picnic reimagined as a nostalgic summer illustration.

🍋 Lemon Weekend — A bright café table turned into a textured lifestyle poster.

🌸 A Gentle Morning — A flower-filled street transformed into a romantic painted scene.

Same technique. Four completely different results.

And here’s the best part: you can try it with your own photos.

⸻

THE FULL PROMPT (Copy & Paste)

Using the uploaded photograph as the primary visual reference, create a premium 3:4 vertical editorial art poster featuring a realistic photograph and its artistic oil painting transformation.

COMPOSITION

Divide the canvas into two equal horizontal sections, each occupying exactly 50% of the total height.

Do not add borders, collage frames, tape, torn paper effects, or decorative separators between the sections.

TOP SECTION — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH

Preserve the original photograph as faithfully as possible.

Maintain the subject’s identity, composition, position, proportions, colors, lighting, perspective, and overall atmosphere.

Do not add, remove, replace, or significantly alter important objects.

Only subtle color correction and natural image extension are permitted.

BOTTOM SECTION — OIL PAINTING TRANSFORMATION

Recreate the same scene as a sophisticated impasto oil painting.

Use thick, expressive palette-knife strokes, visible paint texture, layered pigments, and authentic canvas-like details.

Preserve the recognizable shapes, spatial relationships, and important elements of the original photograph.

Allow natural brushstrokes to extend into a warm, cream-colored paper background, creating an elegant, handcrafted artistic effect.

ART DIRECTION

Inspired by summer travel magazines, contemporary editorial illustration, Mediterranean color palettes, and premium gallery prints.

Use vibrant yet harmonious colors, expressive textures, and carefully balanced negative space.

Add one original, expressive English headline to the bottom section, along with a few subtle editorial annotations.

Typography should complement the artwork without distracting from the main subject.

QUALITY REQUIREMENTS

High resolution, detailed brushwork, natural lighting, realistic depth, sophisticated color harmony, and professional editorial composition.

Avoid cartoon aesthetics, plastic textures, excessive saturation, distorted objects, duplicated subjects, unnecessary decorations, and watermarks.

The final result should feel like a beautiful, handcrafted oil painting featured in an independent art and travel magazine.

⸻

RAVEN’s Tips

• Use photos with clear subjects and interesting colors.

• Travel scenes, cafés, food, flowers, and summer still lifes work especially well.

• If the AI changes important details, add:

“Preserve the original composition, object count, proportions, and spatial relationships. Apply artistic transformation only to the lower section.”

• Generate each photo separately for better control.

The examples shown are AI-generated visual demonstrations. Results may vary depending on the model and reference image.

仅允许轻微的色彩校正和自然的画面延展。

允许自然的笔触延伸至温暖的米白色纸张背景，营造优雅的手工艺术效果。

艺术指导

灵感来源于夏日旅行杂志、当代编辑插画、地中海色彩搭配以及高端画廊级艺术微喷输出。

使用明快而和谐的色彩、富有表现力的肌理，以及精心平衡的留白。

在下半部分添加一句原创且富有表现力的英文标题，并配以几处细微的编辑性注释文字。

排版应与 artwork 相得益彰，同时不喧宾夺主，转移对主体的注意力。

质量要求

高分辨率、精细的笔触、自然的光线、真实的景深、高雅的色彩和谐，以及专业的编辑构图。

避免卡通风格、塑料质感、过度饱和、变形的物件、重复的主体、多余的装饰和水印。

最终效果应像一幅精美的手工油画，刊登在独立艺术与旅行杂志上。

RAVEN 的小贴士

• 使用主体清晰、色彩有趣的照片。

• 旅行场景、咖啡馆、美食、花卉和夏日静物尤其适合。

“保留原始构图、物件数量、比例和空间关系。仅将艺术变体应用于下半部分。”

• 每张照片分别生成，以便更好地控制效果。
